'''Bryn Shal''' was the Head [[Scientist/Legends|Scientist]] of [[Project Wayfarer|Project: Wayfarer]], a [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|Republic Scout Service]] exploration program to explore the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood]] and [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sectors]]. He reported to the [[Senate Committee on New World Discovery and Exploration]].
